Discover the beauty of Bulgarian roses, thoughtfully brought into your everyday skincare ritual.

From Our Fields, With Care.

Nestled in Bulgaria's renowned Valley of Roses, Rosart cultivates Damask roses in its own certified organic fields. From nurturing each rose to fresh distillation and in-house production, we oversee every stage with care, preserving the authenticity and natural character of this treasured botanical ingredient.

Freshly harvested Damask roses are carefully distilled to capture their natural essence. By bringing cultivation, distillation and skincare production together, Rosart maintains a close connection to its ingredients — from the rose fields to the finished product.

Alongside traditional distillation methods used to extract essential oils and botanical extracts, Rosart also uses cold pressing to obtain plant oils. Its organically certified oils and extracts reflect a commitment to carefully selected botanical ingredients and thoughtful skincare production.

Rooted in the beauty of Bulgarian roses, Rosart brings together carefully selected botanical ingredients and thoughtful skincare formulations. From gentle daily essentials to nourishing facial care, each product reflects our commitment to quality, nature and everyday wellbeing.
